ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels with very low high-intensity (white) pixel frequency, estimated at a ratio of approximately 98:2.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive contiguous dark region covering over 95% of visible surface area. Concentrated light-grey/white irregular mottling localized around the median notch junction. Sparse, high-intensity white punctate spots scattered across the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with an approximate internal pixel angle of 45-50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the primary trailing edge. Amplitude increases significantly at the distal tips, forming distinct jagged peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory following a symmetrical arc from the median notch to the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of small, circular high-contrast white spots located on the mid-left lobe surface and near the lateral margins of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized irregular depigmentation and scarring at the apex of the median notch extending into the proximal lobe regions.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced white scarring/pigmentation at the extreme distal tip of the right lobe.
